market_schedule_valid.name: market_schedule_valid
market_schedule_valid.value: "market_schedules"."weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND "market_schedules"."opens_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "market_schedules"."closes_minute" > "market_schedules"."opens_minute" AND "market_schedules"."closes_minute" <= 1440 AND "market_schedules"."cutoff_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 10080 AND "market_schedules"."delivery_delay_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440 AND "market_schedules"."delivery_duration_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "market_schedules"."delivery_fee_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

packed_item_valid.name: packed_item_valid
packed_item_valid.value: "order_items"."packed_at" IS NULL OR ("order_items"."fulfilled_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."fulfilled_quantity" > 0)

order_item_valid.name: order_item_valid
order_item_valid.value: "order_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "order_items"."price_cents" >= 0 AND ("order_items"."fulfilled_quantity" IS NULL OR "order_items"."fulfilled_quantity" BETWEEN 0 AND "order_items"."quantity") AND ("order_items"."actual_cost_cents" IS NULL OR "order_items"."actual_cost_cents" >= 0)

order_assignment_valid.name: order_assignment_valid
order_assignment_valid.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('claimed', 'shopping', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivery_failed', 'delivered') OR "orders"."driver_id" IS NOT NULL
